subject: REVIEW 0aaffe3: B1/B2/B3 fixes confirmed; 0 hard blockers, 2 residual risks
body:
Hashes at review: compute_frontend.m f2f35ec6, runtime_pipeline.inc 4992a4bd, render_pipeline.inc e3ce170c, render_encoder.inc 0163396c, compositor_submit.inc c6189a6e, host Mali .so 57db4be4.
B1 OK: native-config routing now buffer_only (all bound resources are buffers) -> legacy TDG1/TGP1 (compute_frontend.m ~1776); anything else -> v2 with require_v2=1. Probes: tgp1_tdg2_probe (real bridge) TDG1 on TGP1 rc=0/submit; TGP2 buffer-only package (tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2 on probe-compute.spv, 448 B TGP2) + TDG2 built from its manifest rc=0/submit. So 'texture bound but unused' now yields a TGP2+TDG2 job that the bridge accepts. B2 OK: v2Buffers[31], release loop 31, static asserts pass (v2buffers_fixed_probe.m, -Werror syntax). B3 OK: calloc(32) once, count stored with release, execute reader acquire (compositor_submit.inc:241). clear_variants/free only reachable from tegu_render_generic_prepare/set_modules/retranslate, all inside newRenderPipelineState construction before the pipeline escapes; dealloc frees only after jobs release the pipeline. v2 required: tegu_generic_v2_required (render_encoder.inc:2191) forces v2 for flags/compare/level/layer and for any sampler failing tegu_sampler_legacy_word_ok (all samplers carry exact state), build_job refusal -> -13, so o->sampler=0 is never reduced under NORD2_JM_TRANSPORT.
Residual risks: (1) a stale bound-but-unused texture/sampler now moves a buffer-only kernel from the qualified TGP1 path to TGP2 AND subjects the whole command to Rust compute_state validation + the 32-resource cap; suggest falling back to the legacy path when the v2 plan holds only buffer descriptors, region_count==1 and mode==0. (2) Removing the -9 refusal is only safe under NORD2_JM_TRANSPORT: the non-JM tegu_generic_draw_job_build path would silently use sampler word 0; keep the refusal under #ifndef NORD2_JM_TRANSPORT. (3) genericVariantCount readers in render_encoder.inc:2140/2195 are plain loads (fine in practice, commit orders them), and variant_select is still unlocked for two app threads encoding one pipeline. Addon SHA 2019660a not inspected (no unpack/device).
